This case runs with maintainer-tools/skill-evals/run-outside-eval.sh, not claude plugin eval: its Gradle build
needs to bind local ports, which the eval's sandbox doesn't allow. run-baseline.sh reads this file.

Gradle 6.9 also fails at start-up inside Claude Code's own sandbox ("Could not create service of type
BuildLifecycleAwareVirtualFileSystem ... Operation not permitted"), so the line below runs this case's commands
without it. Each run is a fresh temporary workspace with only the case's tools, and the tests run under the airgap
agent, but the session's shell can read whatever the maintainer running it can.
sandbox: off
